kit.cover_letter:
I am writing to apply for the MERN Developer - Intern role at Nxtwave Disruptive Technologies Private Limited in Bangalore. As an MCA student at PES University with hands-on experience building full-stack applications using the MERN stack, I am eager to contribute to your engineering team through this 6-month internship and full-time opportunity.

During my internship at Sunflower Trip as a Full Stack Developer Intern, I built a production-ready system using Node.js, Express, Angular, and MySQL, which was deployed live for real customer bookings. I also implemented role-based access control and secure authentication workflows to separate admin and user functionality.

In my personal and hackathon projects, such as Zenvest and DriftGuard, I utilized the MERN stack to build scalable web applications featuring JWT authentication, Joi-based request validation, and API integrations, deploying services independently across Vercel, Render, and MongoDB Atlas.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how my MERN stack experience aligns with your team's needs.
